Ghora Katora Rajgir: Bihar's Most Beautiful Lake | Highest Buddha Statue | Full Travel Vlog
Ghora Katora Lake Rajgir: Is this the Most Beautiful Lake in Bihar? Welcome to the ultimate Rajgir travel vlog where we explore the stunning Ghora Katora (ghora katora), a natural lake surrounded by lush green hills! In this full Bihar tourism guide, you'll see the majestic Highest Buddha Statue in the water, check out the Ghora Katora boating experience, and get all the tips for your Rajgir trip plan in 2024-2025. Watch till the end to find out how to reach the Horse Bowl Lake without a motor vehicle!
